text: Ana arrived for her piano lesson wearing a blue cloth mask. Near the entrance, a box of spare masks stood beside the attendance sheet. She adjusted her mask, washed her hands, and crossed the studio to the piano. Her teacher wore a white mask and placed the music book on the stand. “Begin with the scale,” the teacher said through the mask. Ana played each note while the loops of her mask rested behind her ears. During the exercise, she noticed several patterned masks hanging from hooks near the window. The teacher tapped the rhythm with a pencil, then adjusted the edge of the white mask. Ana repeated the passage, keeping her mask on as her fingers moved across the keys. At the break, she replaced her blue mask with a gray mask from her bag. She folded the blue mask and put it in a small case. After one final chord, Ana closed the piano, checked the gray mask, and passed the box of masks on her way out.
